Hey @ARCoder181105 ,

The refactor is well-structured: replacing the three parallel maps with a single `directionScheduleGroup` accumulator makes the new frequency path easy to add and the existing headsign-vote logic easier to follow. The frequency spec steps are correctly implemented. References staying populated on no-service dates matches Java (live-verified on Unitrans). Two optional defensive notes inline; everything else looks good.

**Actionable comments posted: 2**

Inline comments:
In `@internal/models/frequency.go`:
- Around line 50-57: Update NewScheduleFrequencyFromDB to construct its
frequency window through NewFrequencyWindowFromDB instead of duplicating the
database-to-window conversion logic, ensuring the shared helper is the single
conversion path.

In `@internal/restapi/schedule_for_stop_frequencies_test.go`:
- Around line 38-42: The schedule fixture in the trips.txt data should include
fixed-schedule trips using a different headsign from the frequency trip, and the
assertions should verify that the frequency trip’s headsign wins only when its
expected-run weight exceeds the competing fixed-trip votes. Extend the relevant
tests around the mixed-direction frequency weighting path to cover both outcomes
and the new branch.
